text: This report provides a Security year end overview of the major security incidents across the 192-acre Exhibition Place grounds including roadways, parking lots, event spaces, tenanted areas, during annual fairs, sporting events, those transiting through to attend RBC Amphitheatre or those neighbours using the grounds as their back yard for exercise or to exercise their pets.
The Board of Governors of Exhibition Place: 1. Received the report (March 31, 2026) from the Chief Executive Officer, Exhibition Place for information.
